title: Warsh tightened more by pausing than by lifting rates, this bond-market veteran argues. Here’s the math.
summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh may have tightened the economy more through pausing rate increases than he would have by actually raising them, according to a bond market expert's analysis.
content: It sounds paradoxical, but Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh may have tightened the economy by not lifting interest rates than he would have by actually increasing them.
